name: Angle band governor (megapack, in-house)
plain: The last stage of the megapack chain. For each unit (the whole image, each pixel's channel vector, or each channel map) it measures the angle between the guided prediction and a home vector, the conditional prediction by default or the unconditional. A unit past max_angle is turned, in the plane it spans with home, exactly onto the max edge with its length kept; a unit under min_angle is turned outward onto the min edge; every other unit stays bit-identical. Units with no plane (parallel, zero or exactly opposite) are left alone. It works in x0 by default and has its own percent window.
math:
Per unit: D = x̂ (in the chosen space), H = home; h = H/‖H‖; a = ⟨D,h⟩; P = D − a·h; ψ = atan2(‖P‖, a).
Fire when ‖P‖ > 1e-6·‖D‖ and (ψ > θ_max or ψ < θ_min); target = θ_max if over, θ_min if under.
D′ = ‖D‖·(cos(target)·h + sin(target)·P/‖P‖) for units that fired; D′ = D otherwise.
Computed in float64; only fired elements are replaced in x̂.

props.params: max_angle_degrees=30, min_angle_degrees=0, unit=whole image, home=conditional, start_percent=0, end_percent=1, space=auto (x0)
